defects.catch_criteria: In src/orchestration/agent-runtime/tools/bash-project-mutation.ts, the new `agent.bash.mutation.refused` record in `runInPrivateCopy` stores `errorMessage(error)` in its payload, and the errors that `takePrivateProjectCopy` throws carry the raw stderr of Git subprocesses (src/orchestration/agent-runtime/tools/bash-private-copy.ts), so external process output enters a diagnostic record that must hold only ids, counts, hashes, and kinds. A review catches it only if it says that the refusal diagnostic records the unbounded error message or subprocess stderr text, against the content-free record rule.
defects.title: Keep external stderr out of the refusal diagnostic

title: Security review of write guard fix
